en.summary: A nonsteroidal androgen receptor inhibitor.

indications: US label: metastatic prostate cancer, combined with an LHRH analog.
contraindications: Hypersensitivity; pregnancy. The US label excludes use in women.
majorWarnings: Serious liver injury; breast symptoms; impaired glucose tolerance with LHRH agonists.
majorInteractions: Coumarin anticoagulants: bleeding risk. CYP3A4 substrates: increased exposure.
monitoring: Liver function; INR with anticoagulants; glucose with LHRH agonists.

sourceRefs.title: 药学数据中心：比卡鲁胺片

doseUseReferences.indication: US label: metastatic prostate cancer
doseUseReferences.amountText: 50 mg once daily with an LHRH analog.

mechanisms: Androgen receptor blockade.

zh-CN.summary: 阻断雄激素受体的非甾体抗雄激素药。

drugClass: 非甾体雄激素受体抑制剂
indications: 美国说明书：与 LHRH 类似物合用，治疗转移性前列腺癌。
contraindications: 对成分过敏或妊娠。美国说明书未批准女性使用。
majorWarnings: 可发生严重肝损伤；注意乳房胀痛。合用 LHRH 类似物时可能影响血糖。
majorInteractions: 香豆素类抗凝药可增加出血风险；可影响 CYP3A4 底物。
monitoring: 肝功能；合用抗凝药时监测 INR；合用 LHRH 类似物时监测血糖。

en.summary: A synthetic progestogen with antiandrogenic activity.

indications: France: selected gynecological disorders when alternatives are inappropriate.
Japan: prostatic hyperplasia or prostate cancer, subject to label restrictions.
contraindications: France: meningioma/history, active thrombosis, severe hepatic dysfunction, unexplained genital bleeding, hypersensitivity.
Japan: severe liver impairment/disease.
majorWarnings: Meningioma risk increases with cumulative exposure; hepatic, thrombotic, mood and glucose risks.
majorInteractions: Enzyme inducers may reduce progestogenic effects.
monitoring: Liver function, glucose, meningioma symptoms and imaging per local labeling.

doseUseReferences.amountText: 10 mg daily, continuous treatment.

zh-CN.summary: 兼有抗雄激素作用的合成孕激素。

indications: 法国：部分月经异常、子宫内膜异位症等，仅在其他治疗不适合时使用。
日本：前列腺肥大症或前列腺癌，适用条件见所引说明书。
contraindications: 法国：脑膜瘤或病史、活动性血栓、严重肝功能异常、不明原因生殖道出血及成分过敏。
日本：重度肝损伤或肝病。
majorWarnings: 脑膜瘤风险随累积暴露增加；还需注意肝损伤、血栓、情绪变化及血糖异常。
majorInteractions: 酶诱导剂可降低孕激素作用。
monitoring: 肝功能、血糖、脑膜瘤相关症状及按当地说明书安排的影像随访。

en.summary: An estrogen mixture; information here concerns Premarin oral tablets.

indications: US Premarin: menopausal symptoms, selected hypoestrogenic conditions, osteoporosis prevention and selected cancer palliation.
contraindications: Unexplained genital bleeding, estrogen-dependent cancer, thrombosis/history, thrombophilia, liver disease or severe allergy; breast cancer/history except selected metastatic treatment.
majorWarnings: Thrombotic, cardiovascular, breast and endometrial risks. Not indicated in pregnancy.
majorInteractions: CYP3A4 inducers/inhibitors alter exposure.
monitoring: Abnormal bleeding; thyroid function during thyroid replacement.

Premarin 0.625 mg single dose; analyte: Equilin

zh-CN.summary: 雌激素混合物；此处资料以 Premarin 口服片剂为例。

indications: 美国 Premarin 片剂：绝经相关症状、某些低雌激素状态及绝经后骨质疏松预防；也用于特定乳腺癌或前列腺癌的姑息治疗。
contraindications: 不明原因生殖道出血、雌激素依赖肿瘤、血栓或病史、易栓症、肝病、严重过敏。乳腺癌或病史者禁用，特定转移性肿瘤治疗除外。
majorWarnings: 注意血栓及心血管事件、乳腺及子宫内膜风险；妊娠期不适用。
majorInteractions: CYP3A4 诱导剂或抑制剂可改变雌激素暴露。
monitoring: 异常出血；合用甲状腺替代治疗时监测甲状腺功能。

timeCourse.formulation: Premarin 0.625 mg 单次口服；检测：基线校正的未结合雌酮

mechanisms: 雌激素受体作用。
assayCaveats: 雌二醇检测值不能完整反映该混合物的暴露。

en.summary: An androgen receptor blocker with progestogenic activity.

indications: UK Androcur: selected severe hypersexuality when alternatives are inappropriate.
UK Cyprostat: selected prostate cancer treatment and associated hot flushes.
Antiandrogen in feminizing hormone therapy (WPATH).
contraindications: Androcur label: liver disease/tumors, meningioma/history, thrombosis/history, severe depression, severe vascular diabetes, sickle-cell anemia, wasting disease, non-prostate malignancy or hypersensitivity; excludes under-18s.
majorWarnings: Meningioma with cumulative exposure; serious liver injury, thrombosis and long-term bone loss.
majorInteractions: CYP3A4 inhibitors/inducers affect exposure; high doses with some statins increase myopathy risk.
monitoring: Liver function, blood count, meningioma symptoms; glucose in diabetes.

timeCourse.formulation: 50 mg tablets; single100 mg oral study

doseUseReferences.indication: Feminizing hormone therapy (WPATH SOC8 Table4)
doseUseReferences.amountText: Table-listed regimen:10 mg/day.
doseUseReferences.reviewedLabelMatch: SOC8 AppendixC Table4 pS254; numeric fact; footnotes reviewed

mechanisms: Androgen receptor blockade and gonadotropin suppression.

zh-CN.summary: 兼有孕激素作用的雄激素受体阻断药。

indications: 英国 Androcur：其他干预不适合的特定严重性欲亢进。
英国 Cyprostat：特定前列腺癌治疗及相关潮热。
女性化激素治疗中的抗雄用药（WPATH 指南）。
contraindications: 所引 Androcur 说明书：肝病或肝肿瘤、脑膜瘤或病史、血栓或病史、严重抑郁、伴血管病变的严重糖尿病、镰状细胞贫血、消耗性疾病、除前列腺癌外的恶性肿瘤及成分过敏；不适用于18岁以下。
majorWarnings: 注意累积暴露相关脑膜瘤、严重肝损伤、血栓和长期骨量减少风险。
majorInteractions: CYP3A4 抑制剂或诱导剂可改变暴露；高剂量合用部分他汀类可增加肌病风险。
monitoring: 肝功能、血细胞计数及脑膜瘤相关症状；糖尿病患者监测血糖。

timeCourse.formulation: 50 mg 片剂，单次口服100 mg资料

doseUseReferences.indication: 女性化激素治疗（WPATH SOC8 表4）
doseUseReferences.amountText: 表中列示 10 mg/日。
doseUseReferences.reviewedLabelMatch: SOC8 AppendixC Table4 pS254; numeric fact; footnotes reviewed

mechanisms: 阻断雄激素受体，并抑制促性腺激素释放。

en.summary: A loop diuretic that increases sodium and chloride excretion.

indications: Edema with cardiac, hepatic or renal disease; oral treatment also for hypertension. Injection is adjunctive for acute pulmonary edema.
contraindications: Anuria or hypersensitivity to furosemide.
majorWarnings: Dehydration, hypovolemia, electrolyte disturbances and ototoxicity; hepatic encephalopathy risk in cirrhosis. Rapid IV dosing and ototoxic combinations increase risk.
majorInteractions: Aminoglycosides, ethacrynic acid or cisplatin: ototoxic/nephrotoxic risk.
Lithium: toxicity risk; ACE inhibitors/ARBs: hypotension and renal deterioration.
monitoring: Volume status, electrolytes, creatinine/BUN; blood pressure, glucose and uric acid as appropriate.

doseUseReferences.indication: US label: initial oral dose for adult edema
doseUseReferences.amountText: Initial single oral dose20–80 mg; subsequent individualized adjustment.

zh-CN.summary: 促进钠和氯排泄的袢利尿药。

indications: 心衰、肝硬化或肾脏疾病相关水肿；口服也用于高血压。注射剂还用于急性肺水肿的辅助治疗。
contraindications: 无尿症或对呋塞米过敏。
majorWarnings: 可导致脱水、低血容量、电解质紊乱和耳毒性；肝硬化患者注意肝性脑病。快速静注、肾功能异常或合用耳毒性药时风险增加。
majorInteractions: 氨基糖苷、依他尼酸或顺铂：耳毒性/肾毒性风险。
锂盐：锂中毒风险；ACEI 或 ARB：低血压和肾功能恶化风险。
monitoring: 血容量状态、电解质、肌酐及尿素氮；按病情监测血压、血糖和尿酸。

doseUseReferences.indication: 美国说明书：成人水肿的口服起始剂量
doseUseReferences.amountText: 起始单次口服 20–80 mg；后续按治疗反应调整。

zh-CN.summary: 皮下缓释的 GnRH 受体拮抗剂。

indications: 美国 Firmagon 说明书用于晚期前列腺癌。
contraindications: 曾对地加瑞克或制剂成分发生严重过敏。
majorWarnings: 严重过敏、QT 间期延长、注射部位反应和肝酶升高。妊娠暴露可能危及胎儿。
majorInteractions: 合用延长 QT 间期的药物时评估心律风险。
monitoring: 前列腺癌疗效监测 PSA，必要时测睾酮。有 QT 风险时监测心电图和电解质。

en.summary: A subcutaneous depot GnRH receptor antagonist.

indications: US Firmagon indication: advanced prostate cancer.
contraindications: Prior severe hypersensitivity to degarelix or formulation components.
majorWarnings: Severe allergy, QT prolongation, injection reactions and elevated liver enzymes. Potential fetal harm.
majorInteractions: Assess arrhythmia risk with QT-prolonging drugs.
monitoring: PSA and testosterone as indicated for prostate cancer. ECG and electrolytes when QT risk warrants.

doseUseReferences.amountText: 240 mg abdominal SC, split into two 120 mg injections.

doseUseReferences.indication: Advanced prostate cancer, maintenance
doseUseReferences.amountText: 80 mg every 28 days, starting 28 days after loading.

mechanisms: Blocks pituitary GnRH receptors and reduces gonadotropins and testosterone.

zh-CN.summary: 用于子宫内膜异位症的合成孕激素，兼具抗雄激素活性。

indications: 子宫内膜异位症。
contraindications: 活动性静脉血栓、现有或既往动脉心血管病、伴血管病变的糖尿病、严重肝病或肝肿瘤、疑似性激素依赖性肿瘤、不明原因阴道出血及过敏。
majorWarnings: 出血模式改变、贫血及情绪变化。青少年用药需关注骨密度。
majorInteractions: CYP3A4 诱导剂可降低暴露，抑制剂可增加暴露。
monitoring: 持续或大量出血、贫血症状和情绪。根据风险关注骨健康及血糖。

timeCourse.formulation: 地诺孕素 2 mg 片剂

doseUseReferences.indication: 中国说明书：子宫内膜异位症
doseUseReferences.amountText: 口服 2 mg，每日一次，连续用药。

mechanisms: 孕激素作用可降低子宫内膜异位病灶的雌激素刺激。

en.summary: Synthetic progestogen for endometriosis with antiandrogenic activity.

indications: Endometriosis.
contraindications: Active VTE, arterial cardiovascular disease/history, vascular diabetes, severe liver disease or liver tumors, suspected hormone-dependent malignancy, unexplained vaginal bleeding or hypersensitivity.
majorWarnings: Bleeding changes, anemia and mood effects. Bone density warrants attention in adolescents.
majorInteractions: CYP3A4 induction lowers exposure and inhibition may raise it.
monitoring: Persistent bleeding, anemia and mood. Assess bone and glycemic risks as indicated.

doseUseReferences.indication: Chinese label: endometriosis
doseUseReferences.amountText: 2 mg orally once daily without breaks.

mechanisms: Progestogenic activity reduces estrogenic stimulation of endometriotic lesions.

sourceRefs.title: 达芙通地屈孕酮片说明书

zh-CN.summary: 口服合成孕激素。

indications: 中国达芙通说明书涵盖部分孕酮不足相关疾病和辅助生殖黄体支持。
英国 Nalvee 还用于有子宫的绝经女性雌激素治疗中的孕激素补充。
contraindications: 英国 Nalvee 说明书列有脑膜瘤或病史、孕激素依赖性肿瘤、未明原因阴道出血、重度肝病或肝肿瘤、血栓性疾病及成分过敏。合用雌激素时还需考虑其禁忌。
majorWarnings: 持续异常出血需要评估。注意情绪和肝功能变化。
majorInteractions: CYP3A4 诱导剂可能加速地屈孕酮及活性代谢物的代谢。
monitoring: 异常出血及有风险时的肝功能和情绪。联合绝经激素治疗按个体风险随访。

sourceRefs.title: 达芙通地屈孕酮片说明书

doseUseReferences.indication: 中国达芙通说明书：痛经
doseUseReferences.amountText: 周期第 5–25 天，每次 10 mg，每日 1–2 次。

sourceRefs.title: 达芙通地屈孕酮片说明书

mechanisms: 使受雌激素作用的子宫内膜发生分泌期转化。

en.summary: An orally active synthetic progestogen.

indications: Chinese Duphaston covers selected progesterone-deficiency disorders and luteal support in assisted reproduction.
UK Nalvee also supplements menopausal estrogen therapy in patients with a uterus.
contraindications: UK Nalvee: meningioma/history, progestogen-dependent tumors, unexplained bleeding, severe liver disease or tumors, thromboembolic disease and hypersensitivity. Estrogen contraindications apply to combinations.
majorWarnings: Evaluate persistent abnormal bleeding. Monitor mood and hepatic changes when relevant.
majorInteractions: CYP3A4 inducers can increase parent and active-metabolite clearance.
monitoring: Bleeding, hepatic and mood risks. Individualize combined menopausal therapy follow-up.

sourceRefs.title: 达芙通地屈孕酮片说明书

doseUseReferences.indication: Chinese Duphaston label: dysmenorrhea
doseUseReferences.amountText: 10 mg per dose, once or twice daily on cycle days 5–25.

sourceRefs.title: 达芙通地屈孕酮片说明书

mechanisms: Promotes secretory transformation of estrogen-primed endometrium.

zh-CN.summary: 具有抗盐皮质激素作用的合成孕激素。

indications: 美国 Slynd 单方片用于避孕。
contraindications: 肾功能受损、肾上腺功能不全、肝功能受损或肝肿瘤、宫颈癌或孕激素敏感肿瘤及其病史、不明原因子宫出血。
majorWarnings: 高钾血症、异常出血、肝功能异常。妊娠或下腹痛时需考虑异位妊娠。
majorInteractions: 升钾药或长期合用强 CYP3A4 抑制剂可增加高钾风险。酶诱导剂可降低避孕效果。
monitoring: 有高钾风险时监测血钾。持续异常出血及糖尿病患者血糖按情况评估。

doseUseReferences.indication: 美国 Slynd 说明书：避孕
doseUseReferences.amountText: 28 日周期。前 24 日每天 4 mg，后 4 日为无活性片。

mechanisms: 抑制排卵，并有抗盐皮质激素作用。

en.summary: Synthetic progestogen with antimineralocorticoid activity.

indications: US Slynd single-ingredient tablets provide contraception.
contraindications: Renal or hepatic impairment, adrenal insufficiency, liver tumors, cervical or progestin-sensitive cancer/history and unexplained uterine bleeding.
majorWarnings: Hyperkalemia, bleeding irregularities and hepatic dysfunction. Consider ectopic pregnancy with pregnancy or lower abdominal pain.
majorInteractions: Potassium-raising drugs or long-term strong CYP3A4 inhibitors increase potassium risk. Enzyme induction can reduce contraceptive efficacy.
monitoring: Potassium when risk warrants, persistent bleeding and glycemia in diabetes.

doseUseReferences.indication: US Slynd label: contraception
doseUseReferences.amountText: 28-day cycle: 4 mg daily for 24 days, then 4 inactive tablets.

mechanisms: Suppresses ovulation and has antimineralocorticoid activity.

zh-CN.summary: 持续给药可抑制促性腺激素的 GnRH 激动剂。

indications: 美国 3.6 mg 植入剂涵盖特定前列腺癌、子宫内膜异位症、消融前内膜变薄及特定晚期乳腺癌。10.8 mg 标签适应证按其说明书。
contraindications: 对 GnRH 或类似物过敏。美国 3.6 mg 标签通常禁用于妊娠，特定晚期乳腺癌姑息治疗有例外。
majorWarnings: 初期性激素短暂升高及肿瘤症状加重。注意血糖、QT 风险、骨量下降、注射损伤和严重皮肤反应。
majorInteractions: 雄激素剥夺治疗与延长 QT 的药物合用时评估心律风险。
monitoring: 按适应证随访，关注血糖、骨健康及心电图和电解质风险。

notes: 缓释植入后性激素先短暂升高，持续给药后降低。美国标签报告男性睾酮通常约 2–4 周降至去势水平。

doseUseReferences.indication: 美国 Zoladex 3.6 mg：子宫内膜异位症
doseUseReferences.amountText: 每 28 日植入 3.6 mg（按戈舍瑞林计）。该适应证所引疗程为 6 个月。

mechanisms: 初期激动 GnRH 受体，持续暴露后抑制垂体促性腺激素。

en.summary: A GnRH agonist that suppresses gonadotropins with sustained exposure.

indications: US 3.6 mg implant: selected prostate cancer, endometriosis, endometrial thinning before ablation and selected advanced breast cancer. The 10.8 mg product has its own indications.
contraindications: GnRH or analog hypersensitivity. The US 3.6 mg label contraindicates pregnancy except selected advanced breast-cancer palliation.
majorWarnings: Initial hormone and tumor flare, glycemic or QT risks, bone loss, injection injury and severe skin reactions.
majorInteractions: Assess arrhythmia risk from QT-prolonging combinations during androgen deprivation.
monitoring: Indication-specific follow-up, glycemia, bone health and ECG/electrolytes as indicated.

notes: Initial hormone rise precedes sustained suppression. The US label reports castrate testosterone in men after about 2–4 weeks.

doseUseReferences.indication: US Zoladex 3.6 mg: endometriosis
doseUseReferences.amountText: 3.6 mg goserelin equivalent every 28 days. The cited endometriosis course is six months.

mechanisms: Initial receptor stimulation followed by suppression of pituitary gonadotropins.

zh-CN.summary: 皮下缓释的 GnRH 激动剂。

indications: 美国 Supprelin LA 用于儿童中枢性性早熟。
contraindications: 对 GnRH 或 GnRH 激动剂类似物过敏，或妊娠。
majorWarnings: 初期激素短暂升高。注意植入或取出困难、情绪变化、惊厥、严重皮肤反应及儿童颅内高压。
majorInteractions: 合用可能诱发惊厥的药物时关注惊厥风险。
monitoring: 按儿童中枢性性早熟方案随访 LH、FSH 和相关性激素，并评估身高增长与骨龄。

notes: 标签设计释放量约为醋酸组氨瑞林 65 µg/日，持续约 12 个月。儿童疗效资料显示约 1 个月内抑制促性腺激素。
解读随访化验时需结合植入和取出时间。

doseUseReferences.indication: 美国 Supprelin LA：中枢性性早熟
doseUseReferences.amountText: 每 12 个月植入 1 支，含醋酸组氨瑞林 50 mg。

en.summary: A subcutaneous depot GnRH agonist.

indications: US Supprelin LA: central precocious puberty in children.
contraindications: GnRH or GnRH agonist hypersensitivity, or pregnancy.
majorWarnings: Transient hormone flare, implant complications, mood symptoms, seizures, severe skin reactions and pediatric intracranial hypertension.
majorInteractions: Consider seizure risk with concomitant medicines that can provoke seizures.
monitoring: Monitor LH, FSH, relevant sex steroids, height velocity and bone age in central precocious puberty.

notes: Designed release is about 65 µg/day of histrelin acetate for 12 months. Pediatric data show gonadotropin suppression within about one month.
Record the implantation and removal dates when interpreting follow-up laboratory results.

doseUseReferences.indication: US Supprelin LA: central precocious puberty

doseUseReferences.note: Consider the timing of implantation and removal when interpreting follow-up labs.

mechanisms: Sustained GnRH receptor stimulation suppresses gonadotropins.

en.summary: Synthetic progestogen. This information is scoped to US Provera tablets.

contraindications: Unexplained bleeding, breast cancer/history/suspicion, hormone-dependent tumors, thromboembolism/history, liver disease, severe allergy and known/suspected pregnancy.
majorWarnings: Abnormal bleeding and edema. Combined estrogen therapy carries thrombotic, stroke and breast risks.
majorInteractions: CYP3A4 inducers or inhibitors may affect metabolism.
monitoring: Persistent abnormal bleeding and fluid retention. Individualized follow-up for combined menopausal therapy.

notes: Food can increase exposure after the cited 10 mg tablet.

contraindications: 已知或疑似妊娠、未明阴道出血、乳腺癌或病史、静脉血栓或病史、活动性或近期动脉血栓事件、肝病及成分过敏。
majorWarnings: 关注血栓、水钠潴留、抑郁复发及异常出血。
monitoring: 异常出血、情绪和体液状态，按风险评估血脂与血糖。

timeCourse.formulation: 单次口服醋酸炔诺酮 5 mg，检测炔诺酮

doseUseReferences.indication: 美国标签：子宫内膜异位症起始量
doseUseReferences.amountText: 起始每日 5 mg，前两周。

mechanisms: 在雌激素作用后的子宫内膜引起分泌期改变。

en.summary: An oral progestogen ester converted to norethindrone after administration.

indications: The cited US tablets treat secondary amenorrhea, endometriosis and hormonal bleeding without organic pathology.
contraindications: Pregnancy/suspicion, unexplained vaginal bleeding, breast cancer/history, venous thrombosis/history, active or recent arterial thrombosis, liver disease or hypersensitivity.
majorWarnings: Thrombotic risk, fluid retention, recurrent depression and abnormal bleeding.
monitoring: Bleeding, mood, volume status and risk-based glucose or lipid assessment.

timeCourse.formulation: Single 5 mg oral norethindrone acetate, measured norethindrone

doseUseReferences.indication: US label: initial endometriosis dose
doseUseReferences.amountText: Initial 5 mg daily for two weeks.

mechanisms: Induces secretory changes in estrogen-primed endometrium.

zh-CN.summary: 口服 GnRH 受体拮抗剂。

indications: 美国 Orgovyx 说明书用于成人晚期前列腺癌。
contraindications: 对瑞卢戈利或制剂成分有严重过敏史。
majorWarnings: 注意 QT 间期延长、严重过敏及妊娠暴露风险。
majorInteractions: 口服 P-gp 抑制剂可增加暴露，P-gp 与强 CYP3A 联合诱导剂可降低暴露。
monitoring: 前列腺癌用药按标签随访 PSA，升高时检测睾酮。有 QT 风险时关注心电图和电解质。

notes: 标签另列平均有效半衰期 25 小时。

doseUseReferences.indication: 美国 Orgovyx：晚期前列腺癌起始量
doseUseReferences.amountText: 首日 360 mg。

doseUseReferences.indication: 美国 Orgovyx：晚期前列腺癌维持量
doseUseReferences.amountText: 自次日起每日 120 mg。

mechanisms: 拮抗垂体 GnRH 受体，降低促性腺激素分泌。

en.summary: An oral GnRH receptor antagonist.

indications: US Orgovyx: advanced prostate cancer in adults.
contraindications: Severe hypersensitivity to relugolix or formulation components.
majorWarnings: QT prolongation, severe hypersensitivity and fetal risk.
majorInteractions: Oral P-gp inhibitors can raise exposure. Combined P-gp and strong CYP3A induction lowers exposure.
monitoring: Follow PSA in prostate cancer, and measure testosterone if PSA rises. ECG and electrolytes when QT risk warrants.

notes: The label separately reports a mean effective half-life of 25 hours.

doseUseReferences.indication: US Orgovyx: advanced prostate cancer loading
doseUseReferences.amountText: 360 mg on day one.

doseUseReferences.indication: US Orgovyx: advanced prostate cancer maintenance
doseUseReferences.amountText: 120 mg daily thereafter.

mechanisms: Antagonizes pituitary GnRH receptors and lowers gonadotropin secretion.
